future_gate: If any next study is authorized, test one representation-preservation or deployment-consistency variable source-only before any RMT redesign; no target tuning.

K1_OPTIMIZATION_FAILURE.reason: Corrected Adam/StepLR/checkpoint states are matched and valid; no optimizer bug remains in this experiment.

K2_SOURCE_GOOD_TARGET_GENERALIZATION_BAD.reason: Source C0 AP is strong/above P, while Medical C0 pixel AP is below P across all macro epochs.

K3_PIXEL_AUROC_GOOD_AP_BAD.reason: Pixel AP is low relative to AUROC and is the largest residual transfer weakness.

K4_PIXEL_GOOD_IMAGE_BAD.reason: Image AUROC is not the primary deficit in the corrected macro results.

K5_MULTITASK_GRADIENT_CONFLICT.reason: Classification/segmentation cosine is positive; this is not a training-wide proof.

K6_STAGE_FUSION_BOTTLENECK.reason: E14 Brain stage attribution is uneven, but no full cross-epoch causal stage test was run.

K7_TRAIN_DEPLOY_OPERATOR_MISMATCH.reason: Training/deployment maps differ materially on a bounded E14 batch; causal contribution to Medical AP remains unmeasured.

K8_NO_USABLE_SIGNAL_CAPACITY_LIMIT.reason: Parent source and several corrected source metrics are strong; the evidence is not a universal capacity failure.
